transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Since the V-12 vision-inspection station commissioning is scheduled for this weekend, I'd like to get our pre-work review started. Before I approve the work order, I need to check in with maintenance, quality, and safety. We also need to finalize whether the station goes at Cell 3 or Cell 7 — both produce the same product family, so I'd like to hear from each of you on which location makes the most sense and any concerns you have. Who'd like to start?

transcript.text: I can start on the location question. During my fit-up check, I found that the V-12 camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — it won't fit Cell 3. Installing at Cell 7 requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. I recorded all of this in the weekend commissioning file, but it's still awaiting engineering signoff and hasn't been added to the work-order summary yet, so it may not be visible to everyone here.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag something important for quality. We need to make sure this gets incorporated before commissioning proceeds.

transcript.text: I need to flag a safety requirement before the work order is approved. The permit draft is currently waiting for my walkdown notes and does not yet contain that test count, so anyone working from the current permit would not see this requirement. This needs to be incorporated before commissioning proceeds.
